results.title: Audi Field
results.snippet: Description: The iconic 20,000-seat soccer-specific stadium is nestled in a prime location along the capital riverfront, the fastest growing area in downtown D.C, and is the permanent home of D.C. United, the Washington Spirit, and the DC Defenders. Opened in July 2018, Audi Field is a premiere entertainment and event destination and was the host of the 2023 MLS (Major League Soccer) All-Star Game vs. Arsenal FC. Complete with a modern FanDuel sportsbook, 500 premium field-level seats, 31 [...] seats, 31 luxury suites, and one of the steepest stadium grades in sports, Audi Field offers fans a unique experience. The stadium houses various events year-round from corporate outings, music festivals, and world class international sporting events from the Premier League Lacrosse to College Football, and more.

results.snippet: - Richard Meisner: Check the schedule for the Washington Commanders, Howard University (highly recommended) and the University of Maryland. Tailgating is basically a huge party in the parking lot before the game. [...] - Arielle Dist: Unfortunately for timing with this trip, many American football games are Thursday-Sunday, and the Commanders are out of town during your visit. You could do a little trip up to Baltimore for the Ravens game on Oct 26. That’s probably your best bet for largest nearby tailgating experience. Or Howard University has a home game on Oct 25. Or you could take the train up to Philadelphia for the Oct 26 Eagles game. More of a trip, but the train is easy and convenient, with a 1pm game [...] with a 1pm game an overnight stay would be easy but a day trip might also technically be doable, and there will definitely be tailgating options. One notable difference from UK football: reselling American football tickets on sites like SeatGeek is very common, so you can most easily search for tickets there. Still need to be careful of scammers, but I know the UK has a lot more restrictions on that.
